runs.summary: Prevent authenticated job results from being served from cache without authorization checks.

findings.issue: The result endpoint returns media responses with immutable cache headers even though access depends on the authenticated account and a time-limited job record. A cached response can bypass loadJob on subsequent requests, serving the result after authorization changes or job expiry; public caching can also expose it to other accounts. Override cache

runs.summary: Defer caller-tool execution until its complete arguments arrive.

findings.issue: Function calls emit tool-input-available on response.output_item.added, when Responses streaming arguments are still empty. The completed function_call item is then ignored, so useChat can execute caller tools with an empty string instead of the generated arguments. Emit function-call input availability on output_item.done instead.
